title: Federal aid.
bodyText: The provisions of section 91-14 shall not be applicable where such applicability would jeopardize federal aid or grants of assistance.
bodyHtml: §91-17  Federal aid.  The provisions of section 91-14 shall not be applicable where such applicability would jeopardize federal aid or grants of assistance. [L 1961, c 103, §19; Supp, §6C-17; HRS §91-17]
